label: DailyEnergyFlowState
info:
Reads Daily Energy Flow State from registers:
- 62: Generator
- 70-71: Battery charge/discharge
- 76-77: Grid buy/sell
- 84: Load
- 108: PV

Triggers:
1. Daily at 23:59
2. Manual
3. RPC: getDailyEnergyFlowState

name: Prepare read (Gen/Batt 62-71)
Prepare read (Grid/Load 76-84)
Prepare read (PV 108)
Build DailyEnergyFlowState JSON
